properties.name: Karachi
properties.selection: purposive: roofs brighter in NIR/SWIR than in any calibration area
properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --bright to measure the rooftop classifier on roofs that read bright in near and shortwave infrared (white, metal and sheet roofs, bare concrete and mud), which it over-credits and which no calibration area holds in numbers: 40% of this window's roofs are brighter than 99% of calibration roofs. Chosen on roof brightness, not on solar, so its share of roofs with solar is whatever it is: map every installation, ground and rooftop, and if there is none, say the box was checked in full. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-05-17 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2024-11-01 for a composite starting 2025-11-01.
